problem: The v3 reference labeler correctly requires at least two branches for an external/pre-update Hyperposition state, but u_state may legitimately collapse >=2 exactly equivalent branches to one via EXACT_FORMAL_SEMANTIC_SIGNATURE and then sends that derived singleton through project_state -> _validate_state, which rejects it as STATE_REQUIRES_AT_LEAST_TWO_BRANCHES.
observed_source_chain: _merge_exact_equivalents groups by deterministic _semantic_signature and records merged_from_branch_ids plus merge provenance
u_state applies _merge_exact_equivalents and immediately calls project_state(world, out)
project_state calls the same strict _validate_state without knowing whether the singleton was produced by the current exact-merge transition

rejected_repairs.repair: Change _validate_state to accept every singleton when world.merge_policy == EXACT_FORMAL_SEMANTIC_SIGNATURE
rejected_repairs.reason: Unsafe: a caller can submit an arbitrary singleton under that world policy and bypass the initial Hyperposition >=2-branch invariant.

rejected_repairs.repair: Trust serialized merged_from_branch_ids/A.merge_policy fields on a singleton
rejected_repairs.reason: Insufficient: caller-controlled provenance-shaped fields are not proof that the current transition actually merged >=2 exactly equivalent prior branches.
Unsafe: it weakens unrelated structural/provenance/evidence checks and converts one state-shape conflict into a broader fail-open path.

recommended_repair.law: Separate strict external-state validation from proof-carrying derived post-merge validation.

external_preupdate_validation.purpose: Preserve semantic Hyperposition as unresolved alternatives at admission/pre-update boundaries.

singleton_allowed_only_if: the immediately preceding validated state contained at least two branches
the current u_state transition itself invoked _merge_exact_equivalents
the singleton output is accompanied by an internal transition witness, not merely caller-serialized marker fields
the witness names >=2 distinct predecessor branch ids present in the validated pre-merge state
all named predecessor branches recompute to the same deterministic _semantic_signature
the output branch recomputes to that same semantic signature for merge-defining fields
merged_from_branch_ids is deterministic/sorted and exactly matches the witness predecessor set
A.merge_policy, A.semantic_signature_sha256 and merged_origins are consistent with the recomputed predecessor set
derived_post_merge_validation.purpose: Represent a legitimate resolution-by-exact-equivalence without making singleton state a general caller-admissible shape.

implementation_shape.preferred: Keep _validate_state strict by default. Add a narrowly scoped internal derived-state validation path or validation context used only by u_state after exact merge, carrying a nonserialized transition witness derived from the already validated pre-merge state.
implementation_shape.do_not: Do not make a boolean allow_singleton caller API sufficient authority.

mandatory_regressions: singleton carrying forged merged_from_branch_ids without current-transition witness fails
two non-equivalent predecessor branches cannot create a valid singleton witness
pre-merge-state digest substitution fails if digest-bound witness is used
full retained v3 reference-labeler suite is classified repository-bound, not just the formerly failing test

next_exact_action: Implement the phase-separated validation/witness repair in the single retained v3 labeler lane, add the mandatory negative regressions, run the complete reference-labeler suite on exact source, and preserve zero dataset/J-Space/HCU/training credit until repository-bound execution plus the upstream P0/P1 gates pass.
